body:
Apple announced the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max on 9 September 2026 at US$1,199 and US$1,299, each US$100 above the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max. Pre-orders opened on the Saturday after the event and the phones began shipping on 18 September.

What is new

  • Chip: the A20 Pro, built on a 2 nanometre process, with a 6-core CPU (two high-performance cores and four efficiency cores), a 7-core GPU Apple says is 40% faster on graphics, and a 32-core Neural Engine.
  • Camera: a 48-megapixel Fusion main camera with variable aperture.
  • Display: a smaller Dynamic Island that can show three Live Activities at once.
  • Battery: the Pro matches the iPhone 17 Pro Max for battery life, and the Pro Max is rated up to 30 hours of video.
  • Colours: black, glacier blue, silver and burgundy.

The keynote itself

It was John Ternus's first keynote as Apple's chief executive, eight days after he succeeded Tim Cook. Apple also showed a folding model called the iPhone Duo.

How to read the price

The US$100 rise applies to the US launch prices. Prices elsewhere vary with taxes and exchange rates, so check Apple's local store.

Should you upgrade

If you own an iPhone 16 Pro or older, the chip and battery changes may matter. If you have a 17 Pro, the headline difference is the camera aperture and the chip.
